ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with high-intensity (white/grey) pixels concentrated at the distal tips; ratio heavily skewed towards low-intensity values.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central and medial fluke regions are solid low-intensity black; high-contrast white mottling and light-grey focal clusters are mapped to the outer 15% of the left and right lobe tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped central depression with an obtuse interior angle and moderate bounding-box depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-frequency, low-amplitude irregularities along the medial trailing edge transitioning to higher-frequency serrations at the lateral lobe extremities.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge exhibits a distinct concave curve originating from the median notch and extending to the acute lobe tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast white pixel clusters localized on the trailing edge of the right lobe tip and scattered across the distal left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint vertical linear pixel disruptions visible on the mid-left lobe ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular, notched pixel boundary on the extreme lateral tips of both lobes indicating possible prior tissue loss or wear.
